lines.en: Ever since I was a child, I have dreamed of starting my own business.
Her ambition is to become a doctor, so she studies harder than anyone I know.
If I could live anywhere in the world, I would choose a quiet place near the sea.
He hopes to run a marathon before he turns forty, although he has never been a fast runner.
Achieving your dreams takes more than talent; it takes patience and daily effort.
I would love to write a book one day, even if nobody reads it.
She is saving money so that she can study abroad next year.
My biggest dream is not to be rich, but to do work that helps people.
Unless you try, you will never know how far you can go.
When I finally achieve this goal, I will look back and be proud of the journey.
